crops.name: Tulips (bulbs/cut)

soil.index: Aim for P and K index 3 (Teagasc). Take a soil test every 4–5 years.

conventional.lime: Lime to keep pH 6.0–7.5; apply ground limestone per soil test (typically 2.5–7.5 t/ha), ideally a few months before sowing.
conventional.manures: Account for slurry/FYM nutrients (Teagasc Green Book values) and stay within Nitrates Regulations limits (170 kg/ha organic N whole-farm; derogation rules apply).
conventional.timing: Apply P & K at or before sowing; split N to match crop demand. Observe closed periods for fertiliser and slurry.

organic.text: Compost; low N for good flowering.
organic.lime: Lime to keep pH 6.0–7.5; apply ground limestone per soil test (typically 2.5–7.5 t/ha), ideally a few months before sowing.

water.rainfall: Regular watering in dry spells, especially in pots/tunnels.

harvest.storage: Cut flowers: harvest early morning, condition in water at 2–5°C.

conventional.pests: Aphids, slugs, botrytis, thrips, fungal leaf spots.

organic.pests: Good airflow, resistant varieties, biological controls under cover.

crops.rotation: Rotate annual beds; bulbs on fresh ground every few years.
